answers.question: Fixture shapes and the exact JSON paths the tally used (keys differ between the two families)
answers.answer: w412_corpus_min.json is a list of 27 rows {row, created_at, input_type, schema_version, product_names, full_response}; input_type = camera 16 / text 7 / text_stream 4; created 2026-03-13 .. 2026-06-21; schema_version 2 on 26 rows, 1 on row 6 (whose full_response is {metadata} only: no products, no winner, the only sub-2-product row). full_response key presence: metadata 27, winner_index/products/scoring/comparison/recommendation/category_used 26, overview+category 23 (rows 3-5, 7-26), scoring_v2 18 (rows 9-26 only). NO row carries a top-level `specs` key (the file is the W4-12 unit's MINIMIZED corpus), so specs_comparison was read from comparison.specs_comparison (dict {product_0_advantages[], product_1_advantages[], similar[]} on 25 rows, None on rows 6 and 24). lane1/*_response.json: 9 single responses, every one with products[], overview.products[], specs.products[], specs.specs_comparison AND comparison.specs_comparison (same three keys, equal sizes), scoring_v2.dimensions (3 dims; iphone15 4), metadata.timestamp 2026-06-08; no `rows` key under either specs_comparison. Paths used per row: products = full_response.products (fallback overview.products); price = products[i].price {amount, currency, retailer, source_method, estimated, unavailable, ...} (unavailable present only on 3 pended corpus prices; source_method None on 5 corpus prices incl. both of row 0; price None on 3); ratings = products[i].rating + products[i].rating_derived (True on 19 of 52 corpus products, never in lane1); dims = scoring_v2.dimensions[] {key, score_a, score_b, confidence in {high, medium, low}, caption_key ('limited_data' on 13 of 86 corpus dims, never another value)}; specs rows recomputed from products[i].specs (dict; `_`-prefixed keys skipped). Tier-3 markers: only 3 corpus products carry specs._field_confidence (row 18 p0 {_cache: db}; row 26 p0 smart_fallback x3 + tier2_fallback; row 26 p1 smart_fallback x4 + concentration: tier3_synthesis), so the R-A4 'tier-3 specs do not count' exclusion is NOT measurable on these fixtures.

answers.question: Placeholder (e) and same-identity (f) refusals, with the two sensitivities that matter for B1's result_gate.py
answers.answer: (e) Placeholder (casefold, punctuation -> space, collapse whitespace; in {'', unknown, unknown product, n/a, product, this product}) on the NAME: 0 of 35 two-product rows; 1/36 counting the product-less v1 row. On the BRAND alone it would fire on 5 corpus rows (w412:15-19, brand '' on both products: the pre-split text path of June 2026, names 'Iphone 17', 'iphone 17 pro max', 'Galaxy S25 ultra'...), all of them coverage 3-4 rows with real prices and ratings, so the rule must run on the identity (dedup_brand_name(brand, name)) or the name, never on brand alone. (f) same_identity per R-A5 (normalized dedup_brand_name equality, OR equal normalized brand AND name-token Jaccard >= 0.9): 0/35. Highest within-pair Jaccard in the corpus is 0.714 (w412:26 'TOM FORD OUD VOYAGER 100 ML' vs 'TOM FORD OUD WOOD 100 ML'), then 0.5 (w412:15 'Iphone 17' vs 'Iphone 17 pro max'; w412:22/23 Oud Wood vs Black Orchid 100 ml). Sensitivity: a NAME-ONLY identity (Jaccard >= 0.9 without the brand) would wrongly refuse 2 of 9 lane1 rows: grocery (Bertolli vs Carbonell 'Extra Virgin Olive Oil', Jaccard 1.0) and now_vs_solgar (NOW Foods vs Solgar 'Vitamin D3', Jaccard 1.0); the brand must stay in the identity. Combined refusal by (e) or (f): 0 real rows (0%), i.e. the identity half of the gate abstains on nothing in these fixtures; its cases (V07 same product twice, 'Unknown Product') are simply not represented in either fixture family.

answers.question: The script (quoted) and how to reproduce the tally
answers.answer:
Script: C:/Users/SynAckITPC/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-SynAckITPC-Documents-AI/ae650c83-4d2a-4910-a8d4-a47ab213c8c3/scratchpad/r_a4_tally.py (sha256 ef87afa9e73c0f3cd4a0df40a7fd5f15e3edb24dce3a40015ac672202fd2b58a), output r_a4_tally_out.json beside it (sha256 83def0cb459eb18466ffb08deb561ad55e13f8a22c389c98162538c7d9cfcb30). Run: `python -I r_a4_tally.py C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s80-base r_a4_tally_out.json` (reads only the two fixture globs; no app import; ASCII-only stdout). Core predicates, verbatim:

```python
PLACEHOLDERS = {"", "unknown", "unknown product", "n/a", "product", "this product"}
FLAGGED = {"missing", "limited_data", "tier3"}
MARGIN = 3.0
SENTINEL = 50  # scoring_service.MISSING_SCORE
NA_VALUES = {None, "", "N/A", "n/a", "Unknown", "unknown", "None"}
_PUNCT = re.compile(r"[^0-9a-z\u0600-\u06ff]+")

def norm(s):
    s = s if isinstance(s, str) else ("" if s is None else str(s))
    return " ".join(_PUNCT.sub(" ", s.casefold()).split())

def dedup_brand_name(brand, name):      # text_sanitize.py:24-60 semantics
    b = (brand or "").strip(); n = (name or "").strip()
    if not b: return n
    if not n: return b
    bl, nl = b.lower(), n.lower()
    if nl == bl: return n
    if nl.startswith(bl) and len(n) > len(b) and n[len(b)].isspace(): return n
    return f"{b} {n}"

def is_placeholder(s): return norm(s) in PLACEHOLDERS

def jaccard(a, b):
    ta, tb = set(norm(a).split()), set(norm(b).split())
    return 1.0 if not ta and not tb else len(ta & tb) / len(ta | tb)

def is_num(x): return isinstance(x, (int, float)) and not isinstance(x, bool)

def price_task(pr):                     # (a) literal task rule (+ estimated:True per price_service:4872)
    if not isinstance(pr, dict): return False
    if pr.get("amount") is None: return False
    if pr.get("unavailable") is True: return False
    if pr.get("source_method") == "estimated": return False
    if pr.get("estimated") is True: return False
    return True

def price_strict(pr):                   # (a) strict: non-empty source_method (is_price_showable:1801)
    return price_task(pr) and bool(pr.get("source_method"))

def rating_real(p):                     # (b)
    return is_num(p.get("rating")) and p.get("rating_derived") is not True

def dim_ok(dim, strict=False):          # (d)
    a, b = dim.get("score_a"), dim.get("score_b")
    if not (is_num(a) and is_num(b)): return False
    if str(dim.get("caption_key") or "") in FLAGGED: return False
    if str(dim.get("confidence") or "") in FLAGGED: return False
    if abs(a - b) < MARGIN: return False
    if strict and (dim.get("confidence") == "low" or a == SENTINEL or b == SENTINEL): return False
    return True

def specs_rows_recomputed(prods):       # response_builder._build_specs_rows:725-762, + N/A exclusion
    s0 = (prods[0] or {}).get("specs") or {}; s1 = (prods[1] or {}).get("specs") or {}
    if not isinstance(s0, dict) or not isinstance(s1, dict): return 0, 0
    fields = list(s0.keys()) + [k for k in s1.keys() if k not in s0]
    code_rows = real_rows = 0; seen = set()
    for f in fields:
        if f.startswith("_") or f in seen: continue
        seen.add(f); v0, v1 = s0.get(f), s1.get(f)
        if v0 in (None, "") or v1 in (None, ""): continue
        code_rows += 1
        if (isinstance(v0, str) and v0.strip() in NA_VALUES) or (isinstance(v1, str) and v1.strip() in NA_VALUES): continue
        real_rows += 1
    return code_rows, real_rows

def specs_rows(fr):                     # (c) literal: GPT prose lists
    sc = (fr.get("specs") or {}).get("specs_comparison") if isinstance(fr.get("specs"), dict) else None
    if not isinstance(sc, dict): sc = (fr.get("comparison") or {}).get("specs_comparison")
    if not isinstance(sc, dict): return 0, 0
    total = sum(len(v) for v in sc.values() if isinstance(v, list))
    disc = sum(len(sc.get(k) or []) for k in ("product_0_advantages", "product_1_advantages"))
    return total, disc

# per row (prods = full_response.products, fallback overview.products; < 2 products -> coverage 0, refused 'no_products'):
#   a = price_task(p0.price) and price_task(p1.price);  a_s = price_strict(...) both
#   b = rating_real(p0) and rating_real(p1)
#   tot, disc = specs_rows(fr); c = tot > 0; c_disc = disc > 0
#   code_rows, real_rows = specs_rows_recomputed(prods); c_rows_real = real_rows > 0
#   d = any(dim_ok(x) for x in scoring_v2.dimensions); d_s = any(dim_ok(x, strict=True) ...)
#   coverage = a+b+c+d; coverage_strict = a_s+b+c_disc+d_s; coverage_auditable = a_s+b+c_rows_real+d_s
#   id_i = norm(dedup_brand_name(brand_i, name_i)); placeholder = is_placeholder(name0|name1) or id_i in PLACEHOLDERS
#   same = id0 == id1 or (norm(brand0) == norm(brand1) and jaccard(name0, name1) >= 0.9)
#   refused = placeholder or same or coverage == 0   (reasons: placeholder_identity / same_identity / no_evidence)
```
Row ids: `w412:<row>` from the corpus `row` field; `lane1:<basename without _response.json>`. The script also prints by-input_type summaries and a per-row line (coverage literal/strict/auditable, a(a_strict), b, c(c_disc), rows code/real, d(d_strict), placeholder, same, Jaccard, partial, refuse reasons, dedup names).

answers.question: Caveats that bound what this offline tally can say
answers.answer: 1) Era skew: corpus rows 0-8 (Mar-May 2026) predate scoring_v2, so (d) is false for them by absence, not by measurement; rows 9-15 (May-June 2) predate the _dim_reviews derived-rating guard (git 1ebc3b08, 2026-06-16) and the A5 suppression (ca60a75c, 2026-06-20): w412:10 (reviews 88/86), 17 (88/84) and 20 (88/82) carry a 'reviews' dim driven by one rating_derived=True rating that today's code would stamp limited_data; (d) on those rows still holds via price/value, so the coverage figures do not move, but the dims-fact is NOT 'measured on both sides' in the R-A4 sense on those rows. 2) The tier-3 exclusion cannot be applied: _field_confidence survives on 3 of 52 corpus products and on the lane1 specs only as smart_fallback markers; w412:26's two surviving dims (character/longevity) are built on smart_fallback and tier3_synthesis specs and still count. 3) `specs.specs_comparison.rows` (L1.9) is absent from every fixture, so (c) was measured on the GPT prose lists and on a recomputation of _build_specs_rows; the code's own rule emits an 'N/A' vs 'N/A' row (only None/'' skipped at response_builder.py:752), which makes 'rows > 0' true on 24/27 corpus rows while only 11/27 have a real two-sided spec row. 4) Row 0 (2026-03) has amounts with source_method None: literal (a) true, is_price_showable false. 5) The 50 sentinel is visible in rows 20-25 (review/reliability/feature_match 90/50, 100/50, 94/50) and inflates margins, though no row's (d) depends on a sentinel dim alone (only_sentinel_d is empty). 6) lane1 is nine WARM text compares (every price local_bhd/converted_usd, every rating verified, 2-10 real spec rows, coverage 3-4): it carries no information about the cold/partial case the critic worries about; the corpus holds exactly 2 partials (rows 24, 26) and 16 camera rows, which is where the thin coverage lives (camera literal {1:7, 2:3, 3:5, 4:1}). 7) Neither fixture family contains a V07 same-product pair or an 'Unknown Product' identity, so (e)/(f) are unsized here (0 hits).

answers.question: Ruling: expected abstain rate and whether the minimum-evidence rule (coverage >= 1) is safe for B2
answers.ruling_text: EXPECTED ABSTAIN RATE on these fixtures, R-A4 as written (coverage >= 1 with the four facts read literally, plus the R-A5 identity rules): 1/36 = 2.8% overall, 1/27 = 3.7% on the production corpus, 0/9 lane1, 0/16 camera, and the single refusal is w412:6, a schema-version-1 row with no products that history already hides and no live compare can produce. By criterion: both prices showable fails 41% of corpus rows (44% strict), both ratings real fails 63%, a discriminating dimension fails 44% (mostly the no-scoring_v2 era), but the OR-of-four coverage rescues everything because the GPT specs_comparison prose exists on 25/27 rows. STRICT reading (showable source_method, advantages-only prose, no sentinel/low dims): unchanged, 1/27. AUDITABLE reading (what R-A4's own words imply: 'discriminating, auditable facts', tier-3 excluded): prices showable per is_price_showable, ratings not derived, a per-spec row with a REAL value on both sides, a non-sentinel non-low dim with margin >= 3 -> 4/27 = 14.8% corpus (3/16 = 18.8% camera, 0 text/text_stream/lane1): w412:6 plus the three Manama Pickles camera pairs (estimated prices, GPT ratings, all-tie dims, 7/7 N/A specs) - exactly the MYEZ-003 'no evidence, still crowned' case. VERDICT: coverage >= 1 is SAFE against over-abstention on every row these fixtures hold, including both hard-cap partials (w412:24 at coverage 1, w412:26 at 2); the critic's fear (most cold compares refused) is not supported offline - but the fixtures under-represent cold fragrance partials (2 of 27), so B1's production count stays the real sizing. The danger runs the other way: as currently specified the rule is near-vacuous, because fact (c) is satisfied by LLM prose (comparison.specs_comparison, part of the verdict JSON at extraction_service.py:1050) or, once B1 reads specs.specs_comparison.rows, by _build_specs_rows rows whose both values are 'N/A' (response_builder.py:752 skips only None/''), so the gate would still crown the Manama Pickles class. NO SOFTENING NEEDED; TIGHTEN THE DEFINITION OF (c) INSTEAD and record three rules in the B1 spec: (1) the specs fact counts only _build_specs_rows rows whose p0_value and p1_value are both outside _SPEC_NA_TOKENS (response_builder.py:625) and, where _field_confidence is present, not tier3_synthesis; never the advantages/similar prose; (2) the dims fact excludes caption_key limited_data, confidence low, and any side equal to the MISSING_SCORE 50 sentinel (no row in the corpus loses coverage from this, so it is free); (3) is_placeholder_identity runs on dedup_brand_name(brand, name) or the name, never on brand alone (5 corpus rows have brand ''), and same_identity keeps the brand (a name-only rule refuses 2 of 9 lane1 rows: Bertolli vs Carbonell olive oil, NOW vs Solgar Vitamin D3). With those three, the expected abstain rate on the recorded bodies is about 15% overall and about 19% on camera rows, all of them rows a reviewer would agree carry no evidence, and 0% on every warm text compare. Re-size with ENABLE_RESULT_STATUS_METADATA in production (one window) before ENABLE_RESULT_GATE flips, watching the camera and partial_stage buckets specifically, because that is where coverage is thin.
